concept.title: Introduction
concept.shortdesc: Harness.io manages the full lifecycle of the CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) process. You can define and automate your build, test, and deployment pipelines using easy-toc-configure YAML files, and the pipelines can also be version-controlled, making updates and changes simpler. Harness supports parallel execution of jobs, allowing you to run builds, tests, and deployments simultaneously.
